meta.title: Create field assist puts wrong visibility on a field
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#21221 (Fix pub in enum variant field for no_such_field)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-12-08 and 2025-12-15; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-12-15. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: The no_such_field fix adds the missing field to the definition; when the definition is in another file it prefixed the field with pub(crate), which is not allowed on enum-variant fields (rustc rejects it only in AST validation, E0449). The result parses and rust-analyzer does not report it, so the case uses the specification probe edit_text_differs with the golden of the fix's regression test.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: the fix's regression test test_add_enum_variant_field_in_other_file_from_usage (crates/ide-diagnostics/src/handlers/no_such_field.rs at a50c1ccc), file /main.rs (cursor marker $0 before baz removed); the issue's snippet uses Foo without importing it, so its no_such_field diagnostic cannot fire as given

the fix's regression test test_add_enum_variant_field_in_other_file_from_usage (crates/ide-diagnostics/src/handlers/no_such_field.rs at a50c1ccc), file /foo.rs; the issue's snippet uses Foo without importing it, so its no_such_field diagnostic cannot fire as given
a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: The issue: with the enum declared in a separate file (foo.rs), a struct-literal use with an unknown field and the 'add field' fix adds 'pub(crate)' to the new variant field. Here (the fix's regression test): open src/main.rs; the field baz of 'foo::Foo::Variant { bar: 3, baz: false}' (line 3, character 32) is reported (no such field); apply its fix. Probe (specification): the edited src/foo.rs must equal the test's golden, which adds 'baz: bool' without a visibility.
